data.title: 厄普西隆 · 四越顶层花园的账目呈阅
data.description: 商会顶层空中花园藤蔓凉亭下，白瓷茶具与三层点心架齐备。厄普西隆双手捧着装帧精致的商会盈利账本，微昂下巴向暗影自豪汇报。
data.location: rooftop greenhouse conservatory terrace covered in blooming wisteria and roses
data.action: seated at wrought iron tea table presenting open gold-leaf account ledger, tilting head proudly with an arrogant yet affectionate smile
data.lighting: 花藤筛落的明媚午后阳光
data.promptProse: Epsilon in a ruffled tea dress presents an ornate financial ledger at a sun-dappled rooftop garden table, tilting her chin up in smug devotion.
data.animaCaption: Sunlight filtering through wisteria blooms gleams on her teacup and gold-embossed ledger.
